text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I feel like my pace in the second half
is falling apart... Why... why is that?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...From the looks of it,
you seem a bit too tense in the shoulders...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see!
Then next time, I'll make a conscious effort
to relax my shoulders!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—!
Epi-san, you've changed... a little, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No, well...
If it were the Epi-san from a little while ago—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I thought to myself that in the past, I wouldn't have paid any mind to words like that.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Until recently, I often let voices other than the 'voice of destiny' slip right past me.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“Lately, though, I feel like I've been able to hear
all kinds of voices much more than before!”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's definitely because I started wanting
to hear Trainer's voice—and everyone's voices—
even more!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, from your Trainer...?
Fufu... that's a nice change of pace, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's awesome! Trainer, you really
always give me the best stuff!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's right, King! Want to run together?
If you notice anything, let me know right away!
